faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: NHSRC is recruiting candidates for 2 vacancies for the post of Consultant - Business Analyst on a short-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Consultant - Business Analyst position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a B.E./ B. Tech./ MCA/ M.E./ M. Tech/MBA from a recognized university or institution along with 7 years or more of experience working as a business analyst.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 50 years as on the date of receiving the application.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by filling out the prescribed application format available on the official NHSRC website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The remuneration range is between Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/- per month, commensurate with qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and candidates may also be subjected to written tests.

faq.question: Q10. What is the work location?
faq.answer: The work location is New Delhi with a willingness to travel on a need basis.
